scope: Measured mesh cost of a cleaning floor. Replaces the withdrawn nearest-feature model with direct measurement: clean the fixed corpus at each floor, mesh the result on a domain fixed by the raw input, count elements. Research only.

handoff.note: This mesher build refuses a maximum edge length on a coverage whose ground has a building nested in it, the same defect as the two meshing integration tests that fail here and not on macOS. Ratios across floors are the claim; absolute counts are not comparable with meshes taken under an edge ceiling.
